title: 23rd Sitting of second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/23/2/2026).

Question from Velidhoo MP Mohamed Abbas to the Minister of Fisheries, Agriculture and Ocean Resources, Ahmed Shiyam: the ministry promised a sports-fishing fish aggregating device (FAD) off N. Velidhoo this year, but no practical work has started; when will it begin and be completed?

Question from Velidhoo MP Mohamed Abbas to the Minister of Fisheries, Agriculture and Ocean Resources, Ahmed Shiyam: the N. Lhohi ice plant has been out of operation for two years with no fix or government action, a major worry for fishing families; when will it be resolved?
First reading of the bill to amend the Foreign Currency Act (Law No. 32/2024), submitted on behalf of the government by Holhudhoo MP Abdul Sattar Mohamed.
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend the Foreign Currency Act (Law No. 32/2024), submitted on behalf of the government by Holhudhoo MP Abdul Sattar Mohamed.

Unfinished business: continued debate on the resolution by Hulhumale South MP Dr Ahmed Shamheed calling on the government to immediately halt the sale of permanent residence permits to foreigners under the "Maldives Pearl Residence Programme" and disclose all related agreements to Parliament.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting took two fisheries questions, introduced and began debating a Foreign Currency Act amendment, and continued the Pearl Residence Programme resolution debate.
